theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Eligible and high-rank, but crowding_z=1.82 and crowded=true signal the strongest extension flag in the top cohort. Per guardrails this is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, never a fade or short — expressed here as an 'avoid new exposure' lean rather than an underweight, because the crowding flag has no validated basket-level forward edge and fading a leader is the documented failure mode.
evidence: crowding_z=1.82, crowded=true (strongest sizing caution in top 5)
theses.dissent: Crowding is coincident and has no validated forward drawdown edge at basket level; a crowded trend can persist for extended periods, and avoiding it forfeits continued leadership participation.

falsifier.text: CIBR outperforms SPY by 5% or more over the 20-day window despite the crowding flag (i.e., the flagship caution produced no underperformance)

theses.subject: AI Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar (0.85) and breadth (0.917) in the entire rank list, with a trend hurst tag and a modest crowding score (0.69, not flagged). The absolute-trend gate keeps it eligible. This is a quality-of-trend lean: the strongest staying-power profile among scorable themes, even though it ranks only 5th on momentum score.
theses.dissent: Momentum score is middling (1.08), and SMH is shared as proxy with several other themes, so attribution is noisy; the durability measure itself is coincident, not a proven forward predictor.
